_purpose: PREREGISTRATION.md T75 with its Amendments 1 to 7: does a single flaw beside a knot (nearest point 1 or 2 steps from a knot point) in the product of a burp (T51's end states, N = 512) heal, stay, travel or spread, and at what speed? A flaw is the cheapest valid switch at a point costing more than zero, priced at lambda = 1.25 (beside a knot, the cheapest touching no knot point). Coupling g = 2.6, fixed by amendment before launch. Not exploratory. At lambda != 1 this is our family, not combinatorial quantum gravity.
